reference_architecture: A, predictor A, unchanged variable scheduler; C70 and grid changes excluded from first profile

clocks.cpu: process_time_ns for worker process; fresh SINGLE
clocks.units: stored integer ns plus derived seconds
clocks.host_vs_simulation: host duration never substitutes for simulated physical time

boundaries.scope: separately time symbolic NLP graph, CasADi/IPOPT backend creation, predictor and TVLQR Jacobian construction, fixture load and terminal schedule initialization; no amortization hidden in runtime
TrajectoryPlanner.prepare prediction block including tracker clone; causal release context only
preview outer total; geometry/reference children explicitly nested, never added twice
shift or cold start and terminal lookup reported separately if measured; retain which path occurred
request packing, parameter vector, preparation overhead outside backend solve
actual IPOPT backend call wall/CPU; solver adapter wrapper, statistics extraction, finite/feasibility evaluation separated as children/residual overhead
controller shape/bounds/constraints and outcome processing; packet validation separately; failure path must retain partial phase coverage
100 Hz TVLQR Jacobians, terminal DARE and backward recursion; optional subphase clocks only after noninterference gate
packet creation/replacement and residual overhead; reconcile exclusive child sums against full outer total; negative/unaccounted residuals investigated

existing_timer_limit: Existing phase clocks are mainly wall-only, total prepare also has CPU. Existing total stops before final packet replacement/return assembly; a new full-call outer timer must retain original planner_total_time and explicitly report its additional boundary overhead. No silent renaming of historical times.

instrumentation_gate.implementation: separate research wrapper/opt-in profiling only after approval; no scheduler event insertion; record serialization/export outside timed kernel
instrumentation_gate.parity: prerequisite exact controlled zero and imposed-delay state/input/packet/reference/authority/RK4 parity versus uninstrumented A; source and fixture hashes match. Measured instrumentation overhead can affect availability: report rather than claim wall-time equality. Future phase-clock insertion requires a reviewable source diff.
instrumentation_gate.observer_effect: paired instrumented/uninstrumented calls in fresh processes; retain all timings and numerical outputs; report clock overhead and full-call delta; no subtraction of an optimistic assumed overhead

proposed_samples.closed_loop_reference: 10 fresh A workers x 2 s, same accepted short initial state and frozen gamma2 fixture; measured planner availability, imposed 5 ms codriver; one launch cohort per worker. Provides preparation CPU/simulated-s metric; no full lap claim.
proposed_samples.representative_context_panel: Separate offline diagnostic panel: 12 release-known contexts (4 low |curvature| straight, 4 sustained high |curvature| corner, 4 entry/exit) drawn by predeclared Planning-curvature quantiles and progress ordering from retained valid A evidence, never chosen by solver timing. 10 fresh workers x 12 calls; report CPU/wall per call, NOT CPU/simulated-s because this panel has no physical execution.
proposed_samples.context_gate: Before approval, freeze exact IDs, hashes and selection algorithm; require actual release state, active packet, tracker state, previous input, target/estimate and warm-start state. If warm-start state cannot be faithfully recovered, explicitly label cold-start panel and seek review; never claim representative warm starts from guessed state. Do not regenerate old evidence.
proposed_samples.warmup: one-time construction/startup separately retained; first recurring call and subsequent calls reported separately; no deletion of cold or slow samples
proposed_samples.missing_strata: report if retained evidence cannot supply meaningful straight/corner strata; no fabricated curvature or vehicle parameters

execution: fresh sequential SINGLE processes; configure supported native backend before numerical imports; retain actual thread observations/backend/version/OS/CPU provenance; no tests/rendering/analysis during measurement
record: source/config/fixture hashes; full per-call nested wall/CPU boundaries and failure paths; solver iterations/status/feasibility; predictor/gain/node counts; RSS; imposed vs measured availability; complete timestamps and stop reasons
stops: missing causal context or unexpected timer reconciliation failure
next: Engineering Review of decomposition before selecting overhead/grid/control-horizon/solver experiments; no automatic follow-on
